duration.text: The Industrial Economics at Shandong University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5000 USD/per year ￥ 36000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8. Application essay 800 words or so in Chinese, regarding major of application and desired direction of study

requirements.text: No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport with good health. Applicants should own master degree in concerned subjects or above.
